name: The Master, Formed Anew
oracle_text:
Body Thief — When you cast this spell, you may exile a creature you control and put a takeover counter on it.
You may have The Master enter as a copy of a creature card in exile with a takeover counter on it.
blocked_sentences: You may have The Master enter as a copy of a creature card in exile with a takeover counter on it.

needs.what: An optional `self_enters_as_copy` replacement whose `copying` pool is a standing selector over cards in exile (`{"zone": "exile", "controller": "any", "types": ["Creature"], "has_counters": "takeover"}`) with no `as_enters` effects, offered as a 'you may' like Clone, and accepted by the residual gate as claiming its printed line
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The engine's `ask_enters_copy` already resolves a non-`as_enters` `copying` pool and asks yes/no, and `has_counters` reads counters on an exiled card, so a card written that way loads -- but the residual claimant in `cards/authoring/verify.py` (`self_enters_as_copy` branch) refuses any line containing the word 'exile' unless the replacement carries `as_enters` (it assumes The Mimeoplasm's 'As ... enters, you may exile ...' shape). Adding a dummy `as_enters` would route through `offer_as_enters_effects`, which picks from the pool with no 'you may', so it is not the printed card. The front line (the stack-zone `spell_cast` trigger with `may` -> `exile` as a binding -> `add_counters` 'takeover') is expressible as-is
